domain.value: video tokenizer (causal wavelet-space autoencoder; continuous AE or discrete FSQ) of the Cosmos-Predict1 generative world foundation models; trained jointly on images and general video (proprietary + open-domain Internet video, 9 content categories)

quotes.quote: Cosmos Tokenizer can serve as an effective and efficient building block in both diffusion-based and autoregressive models for image and video generation.
Model Type: | Auto-Encoder
We train our tokenizers directly on high-resolution images and long-duration videos without limiting the categories or aspect ratios.
3.1 Dataset We use both proprietary video datasets and publicly available open-domain Internet videos to train our models.

architecture.type: causal temporal conv + causal temporal attention autoencoder with 2-level Haar wavelet front end; vanilla AE (continuous) or FSQ (discrete)
architecture.representation: encoder output latent tokens: continuous 16-dim vectors per latent voxel (CV) or FSQ indices, vocabulary 64,000 (DV)

pretraining_data.summary: Tokenizers trained jointly on images and videos; the paper's training dataset = proprietary video datasets + publicly available open-domain Internet videos, ~20M h raw video, 9 content categories (driving, hand/object manipulation, human motion, navigation, first-person, nature, camera motion, synthetic, others 7%). No dataset names for training (TokenBench/DAVIS named only for evaluation).
pretraining_data.form: described only (sources characterised generically; no training-dataset list)

quotes.quote: 3.1 Dataset We use both proprietary video datasets and publicly available open-domain Internet videos to train our models.

1. Driving (11%), 2. Hand motion and object manipulation (16%), 3. Human motion and activity (10%), 4. Spatial awareness and navigation (16%), 5. First person point-of-view (8%), 6. Nature dynamics (20%), 7. Dynamic camera movements (8%), 8. Synthetically rendered (4%), and 9. Others (7%).
In total, we accumulate about 20M hours of raw videos with resolutions from 720p to 4k.
We train our tokenizers directly on high-resolution images and long-duration videos without limiting the categories or aspect ratios.
4.2 Training Strategy We employ a joint training strategy by alternating mini-batches of images and videos at a preset frequency.

embedding_dim.value: CV8x8x8-720p, 121 frames x 720x1280 input: 16 channels x (1+120/8 = 16) x 90 x 160 = 3,686,400 values; generally 16 x (1 + T/8) x H/8 x W/8 for 1+T input frames. DV variants: FSQ indices (6-dim latent, vocabulary 64,000) instead of 16-dim vectors.
embedding_dim.derivation: latent dimension 16 for continuous tokenizers (card + paper); temporal token count 1 + T/s_T (paper Fig. 7); s_T = 8, s_HW = 8 for CV8x8x8
